raw_graphql_pull_request.body:
## Motivation

FLUX.2 on MI355 aborts during the first compiled DiT forward. `residual_gate_add` takes the CUDA Triton fast path because `tensor.is_cuda` is true under HIP. That kernel emits PTX `cvt.rn.bf16.f32` with the CUDA register constraint `=h`. ROCm LLVM treats the constraint as a fatal register-allocation error (`couldn't allocate output register for constraint 'h'`) and kills the diffusion worker before the eager fallback can run. Wan2.2 does not call this kernel, so the same launch script succeeds there.

`main` already skips the path when `torch.version.hip` is set. This change uses the diffusion platform predicate `is_hip()` instead, which is the same check neighboring ROCm kernels use. On NVIDIA, `is_hip()` is false, so the CUDA fast path is unchanged.

## Modifications

- `can_use_residual_gate_add_cuda` returns false when `is_hip()` is true, so Flux2 uses eager `residual + update * gate` on ROCm.
- Added `test/registered/unit/kernels/test_residual_gate_add_hip.py`, registered in CPU CI (`base-a-test-cpu`). One test asserts the CUDA fast path is rejected on HIP. The other asserts `residual_gate_add` matches the eager formula.

## Accuracy Tests

The HIP fallback is eager `residual + update * gate`. Measured max absolute error against that formula:

| Check | Shape | Dtype | Max abs error |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| GPU, MI355 | [1, 128, 6144] | bf16 | 0.0 |
| CPU unit test | [2, 8] | fp16 | 0 (`assert_close`) |

FLUX.2-dev text-to-image at 720p, 8 steps, seed 42, completed and wrote a 1280×720 PNG. The previous run died in kernel compilation and produced no image.

## Benchmarking and Profiling

Same command as the crash, after the guard. One MI355 GPU, `--enable-torch-compile`, `--warmup-mode request`, `--dit-layerwise-offload`.

| Segment | Time |
| --- | --- |
| Full generate, including torch.compile | 176.36 s |
| Request, warmup excluded | 5.00 s |
| Denoising, 8 steps | 4.87 s (0.078 s/step) |
| VAE decode | 0.0049 s |
| Peak memory | 108274 MB |

There is no before-latency. The unguarded PTX path aborts the worker.

## Checklist

- [x] Format your code according to the [Format code with pre-commit](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#format-code-with-pre-commit).
- [x] Add unit tests according to the [Run and add unit tests](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#run-and-add-unit-tests).
- [ ] Update documentation according to [Write documentations](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#write-documentations).
- [x] Provide accuracy and speed benchmark results according to [Test the accuracy](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#test-the-accuracy) and [Benchmark the speed](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#benchmark-the-speed).
- [x] Follow the SGLang code style [guidance](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#code-style-guidance).

## Review Process

1. Ping Merge Oncalls to start the PR flow. See the [PR Merge Process](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/blob/main/.github/MAINTAINER.md#pull-request-merge-process).
2. Get approvals from [CODEOWNERS](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/blob/main/.github/CODEOWNERS) and other reviewers.
3. Trigger CI tests with [comments](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#how-to-trigger-ci-tests) or contact authorized users to do so.
   - `/tag-run-ci-label`, `/rerun-failed-ci`, `/tag-and-rerun-ci`
4. After green CI and required approvals, ask Merge Oncalls to merge.

@@ -8,6 +8,7 @@
 
 from sglang.kernels.jit.utils import cache_once, load_jit, make_cpp_args
 from sglang.kernels.kda_kernels import _cuda_source
+from sglang.kernels.ops.diffusion.common.platform import is_hip
 from sglang.srt.utils.custom_op import register_custom_op
 
 if TYPE_CHECKING:
@@ -230,8 +231,12 @@ def _is_transposed_dense_residual(
 def can_use_residual_gate_add_cuda(
     residual: torch.Tensor, update: torch.Tensor, gate: torch.Tensor
 ) -> bool:
+    # The Triton fast path emits CUDA PTX cvt.rn.*.f32 with constraint "=h".
+    # On ROCm that constraint is a fatal LLVM register-allocation error, so
+    # the caller never reaches its eager fallback. tensor.is_cuda is true on
+    # HIP; the platform predicate is what rejects this path.
     return (
-        torch.version.hip is None
+        not is_hip()
         and residual.dtype in _SUPPORTED_DTYPES
         and residual.dtype == update.dtype
         and residual.dtype == gate.dtype

@@ -0,0 +1,39 @@
+# SPDX-License-Identifier: Apache-2.0
+
+from sglang.test.ci.ci_register import register_cpu_ci
+
+register_cpu_ci(est_time=10, suite="base-a-test-cpu")
+
+import unittest
+from unittest.mock import patch
+
+import torch
+
+from sglang.kernels.kda_kernels.residual_gate_add_jit import (
+    can_use_residual_gate_add_cuda,
+    residual_gate_add,
+)
+
+
+class TestResidualGateAddHip(unittest.TestCase):
+    def test_hip_skips_cuda_ptx_fast_path(self):
+        with patch(
+            "sglang.kernels.kda_kernels.residual_gate_add_jit.is_hip",
+            return_value=True,
+        ):
+            self.assertFalse(can_use_residual_gate_add_cuda(None, None, None))
+
+    def test_hip_residual_gate_add_matches_eager(self):
+        residual = torch.randn(2, 8, dtype=torch.float16)
+        update = torch.randn(2, 8, dtype=torch.float16)
+        gate = torch.randn(1, 8, dtype=torch.float16)
+        with patch(
+            "sglang.kernels.kda_kernels.residual_gate_add_jit.is_hip",
+            return_value=True,
+        ):
+            out = residual_gate_add(residual, update, gate)
+        torch.testing.assert_close(out, residual + update * gate)
+
+
+if __name__ == "__main__":
+    unittest.main()
